defs.def: to be badly affected by a disease, pain, sadness, a lack of sth, etc. （因疾病、痛苦、悲伤等）受苦，受难，受折磨

ex.s: After Charlie had a heart attack, Tindale says, she was prepared to put him to sleep, but Farber’s treatments eased her dog’s suffering so much that she was able to keep him alive for an additional five months.
ex.t: Charlie心脏病发作后，Tindale说，她本准备让它安乐死，但Farber的治疗大大减轻了它的痛苦，让她又能让它多活了五个月。

ex.s: It is so easy to let an online course slide, but your grades will suffer as a result.
ex.t: 在加拿大北部严酷的生存环境下，因纽特人的实用主义道德观是非常合理的。

ex.s: “If you eat too much or do too much of anything, you’re going to suffer eventually,” he said.
ex.t: "如果你吃得太多或做任何事过度，你最终会受苦的，"他说。

ex.s: She suffered from a heart problem.
ex.t: 她患有心脏问题。

ex.s: This makes our body suffer and we will catch other diseases.
ex.t: 这会让我们的身体受苦，我们会染上其他疾病。

ex.s: A tough man can tolerate suffering．
ex.t: A．坚韧的人能忍受苦难。

ex.s: They conclude that when task interdependence is high，team performance will suffer when there is too much talent，while individual talent will have positive effects on team performance when task interdependence is lower.
ex.t: 结果喜忧参半。对于足球和篮球来说，为球队增添有天赋的球员确实是一种好方法，但仅限于当70%的球员是顶尖人才时；超过这个水平，球队的表现就开始下降。

ex.s: A young English teacher saved the lives of 30 students when he took    36    of a bus after its driver suffered a serious heart attack.
ex.t: 一名年轻的英语老师在公交车司机严重心脏病发作后接过____公交车，救了30名学生的命。

ex.s: Paris had suffered a sudden heart failure.
ex.t: 巴黎曾突发心力衰竭。

ex.s: Those who refuse to take that risk selfishly make others suffer.
ex.t: 那些自私地拒绝承担那种风险的人，会让别人受苦。

ex.s: We all love roast beef and vegetables, but Mum says we'd better not eat too much roast food as it may make us suffer from heat inside our bodies, according to traditional Chinese medicine.
ex.t: 我们都喜欢烤牛肉和蔬菜，但根据传统中医的说法，妈妈说我们最好不要吃太多烤肉，因为它可能会让我们体内发热。

ex.s: What was all this suffering for?
ex.t: 为什么这样痛苦？

ex.s: The picture of Dorian Gray This book by Oscar Wilde tells the story of Dorian Gray, a very handsome young man who spends his life only concerned with his own pleasure, regardless of the suffering he brings to others.
ex.t: 《道林·格雷的画像》：奥斯卡·王尔德的这本书讲述了道林·格雷的故事，他是一个非常英俊的年轻人，一生只关心自己的快乐，不管给别人带来多少痛苦。

defs.def: to experience sth unpleasant, such as injury, defeat or loss 遭受；蒙受

ex.s: He became interested in alternative treatments 20 years ago when he suffered from terrible back pain.
ex.t: 20年前，当他遭受严重背痛时，他对替代疗法产生了兴趣。

ex.s: Six months after suffering our （14）     on the spring practice field， we won our first game and our second， and continued to （15）     ．Finally， we faced the number one team in the state． I felt that it would be a （16）     for us even if we lost the game． But that wasn't what happened． My boys beat the best team in Georgia， giving me one of the greatest （17）     of my life！
ex.t: 在春季训练场遭受（14）___六个月后，我们赢下第一场、第二场，并继续（15）___。终于，我们面对全州第一的队。我觉得即使输了，对我们也是（16）___。但事实并非如此。我的孩子们击败了佐治亚最好的队，给了我一生中最伟大的（17）___之一！

ex.s: Visitors shouldn't overlook it because it suffered a lot in history.
ex.t: 游客不应忽视它，因为它在历史上遭受了很多苦难。

ex.s: They suffered severe hardships.
ex.t: 他们遭受了严重的困难。

ex.s: “His family is suffering so much.”
ex.t: "我也是，"Harry说。

ex.s: It suffered a great loss.
ex.t: 它遭受了巨大损失。

ex.s: The loss of big trees was greatest in areas where trees had suffered the greatest water shortage.
ex.t: 大树的损失在树木遭受最严重缺水的地区最为严重。

defs.def: to become worse 变差；变糟
